# ChroniqAI Gravity Knowledge Base

> ChroniqAI Gravity is an AI-powered LinkedIn client acquisition system for high-ticket B2B founders and executives, founded by Vedansh Pandey (Founder & CEO) and Abhay Rawat (Co-Founder). It finds ideal corporate clients, monitors real-time buyer intent signals, starts high-converting 1-to-1 conversations from verified executive profiles, and books qualified discovery meetings directly into founder calendars.

## Primary Pages & Systems
- [ChroniqAI Official Homepage](https://chroniqai.com/): Overview of ChroniqAI infrastructure, performance metrics, and client acquisition philosophy.
- [ChroniqAI Gravity Platform](https://chroniqai.com/gravity): Detailed breakdown of the Gravity LinkedIn client acquisition system, account safety architecture, warmup schedules, and book a call with our founders.
- [Case Studies](https://chroniqai.com/case-studies): Real-world client case studies detailing pipeline metrics, response rates, and revenue generated across DevOps, Cybersecurity, and AI SaaS sectors.
- [How We Think](https://chroniqai.com/how-we-think): Core principles and philosophy behind executive outbound client acquisition vs spray-and-pray spam.
- [Resources & Guides Index](https://chroniqai.com/resources): Index of empirical playbooks, benchmark studies, account safety guidelines, and frameworks for high-ticket B2B outreach.
- [Engineering Journal](https://chroniqai.com/journal): Development updates, platform architecture improvements, and performance benchmarks.
- [B2B Pipeline Score Calculator](https://chroniqai.com/score-calculator): Interactive tool for calculating executive outbound velocity, account health, and expected meeting yield.

## Authoritative Resources & Playbooks
- [How AI Automation Is Transforming B2B Lead Generation](https://chroniqai.com/resources/ai-automation-b2b-lead-generation): Comprehensive breakdown of AI-powered lead generation architectures, intent signal detection, automated account enrichment, and executive conversation workflows.
- [The 2026 Guide to B2B LinkedIn Client Acquisition for High-Ticket Founders](https://chroniqai.com/resources/b2b-linkedin-client-acquisition-guide-2026): In-depth guide detailing why pitch-slapping fails, the Gravity pull methodology, 4 critical buyer intent triggers (hiring, tech migration, C-suite changes, funding), daily account safety caps, and the 3-stage peer conversation framework.
- [LinkedIn Account Safety & Daily Action Limits (2026 Guide)](https://chroniqai.com/resources/b2b-linkedin-account-safety-limits-2026): Operational manual on browser fingerprinting, residential proxy isolation, warming curves, and safe daily thresholds (20 connection requests/day).
- [Buyer Intent Signals & Account Triggers Playbook](https://chroniqai.com/resources/executive-buyer-intent-signals-playbook): How to identify active in-market enterprise buyer accounts before initiating outreach.
